responsibility: Implements conversion and incremental rewriting of GIMPLE into SSA form. It tracks current definitions, collects definition/use sites and liveness heuristics for symbols and old/new SSA names, inserts PHI nodes using dominance frontiers when needed, renames affected regions via dominator walks, manages replacement tables and deferred SSA-name release, and serves as the core engine behind update_ssa and symbol-to-SSA rewriting after CFG or statement transformations.
same_name_distinction: Implements SSA construction and incremental update internals: collecting def/use information, PHI placement, dominator-guided renaming, and update_ssa execution. Unlike gcc/tree-into-ssa.h, this file contains the SSA conversion engine itself.
